fails_if: an unreadable SOS workbook escapes `prepare-sources` as an internal error (SosParseError no longer a ValueError), or the parser returns zero variables for a variable sheet without a Variabelnamn header
note: Before this case SosParseError was a bare Exception, so prepare-sources and prepare-input-bundle reported a malformed SOS workbook as internal_error (exit 30) instead of their configuration error. sos-parse-variable-sheet-without-variabelnamn-refused is the parse-sos twin.
